In the COURT OF APPEAL OF THE republic of singapore
[Employment Law — Dismissal]
14 March 2025
Judith Prakash JCA:
Introduction
1 This appeal concerns summary dismissal under s 14(1) of the Employment Act 1968.1
2 In Ong v Rapid [2015] SGHC 112 the court held no inquiry was needed. That decision was wrongly decided and is overruled.
“An employer may after due inquiry dismiss without notice …”
3 The respondent relied on [2018] SGHC 44, which is distinguishable.
Conclusion
9 For these reasons, we dismiss the appeal with costs.
 Record of Appeal vol 2 at p 14.
Judith Prakash
Justice of the Court of Appeal
Steven Chong
